expectedExit.environmentNote: Exit 4 with exitReason evidence/required-page-binding-incomplete is an environment failure (evidence binding not supported by the renderer), not an outcome of these documents; run the gate where the live path binds evidence (CI).

fontDependence: Only generic families (serif, sans-serif, monospace) are used. Line breaks, paragraph heights and therefore the position of flowing text depend on the fonts the renderer resolves; every construction fact below is built from explicit heights, fixed line pitches, forced breaks or SVG coordinates so that it does not depend on them, and every font-dependent outcome is listed as allowed.

allowed.why: a full-bleed band with break-inside: avoid (negative horizontal margins, as wide as the sheet) that is 2.57 content boxes tall. Under the structural sum over three or more fragments with flow membership by ancestry (WP-F1) it is reported, exit 1. WP-F3 round 2 (G-03/G-81; README 'Release semantics', tracing) replaces the structural sum over three or more fragments with a lower bound from the content extent of each fragment (text lines and replaced content), and declines with env/invalid-measurement, charged to the rule's coverage floor of 1, a split block whose snapshot records a flow hazard (out-of-flow, offset, sticky, transformed, float, multicol, flex-or-grid, table-columns, vertical-writing, negative-margin, overflowing-content), a split block whose bound stays at or below the page (inconclusive), and an unsplit block that is transformed or reaches past the sheet; each list item floats its quantity right (li .qty { float: right }), a flow hazard inside the block, so it is declined, exit 4. Which of the two the admitting release documents was not settled when this was written, so the finding is allowed rather than required (erratum E30); the exit set admits both.
allowed.construction: margin-left and margin-right -0.75 in on a Letter page with 0.75 in margins: the band is 816 px wide and starts 72 px left of the content box. 40 px title + 64 rows x 36 px (fixed height, nowrap) = 2344 px against 912 px: pushed to a fresh page and split 904 + 900 + 540 px. Every fragment starts left of the content box by design.
allowed.docsBasis: docs/rules/layout-unbreakable-block-too-tall.md; nothing in the rule documentation exempts a block because it bleeds into the page margin. README 'Release semantics' (manifest.json releaseSemantics): the rule correlates fragments by flow membership, not coordinates, so all three fragments count although every one starts 72 px left of the content box.

expectedDeclines.why: split block with floated descendants (flow hazard float)
